source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the for loop (PDF 44-45).

blocks.text: for loop code ke block ko ek specific (pehle se tay) number of times dohrata hai. Aam taur par yeh kisi sequence (list, tuple ya string) ki har cheez par ek ek kar ke chalta hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh for loop ki shakal (syntax) hai, poora program nahi.
"for": keyword, chhote letters mein.
"variable": aap ka chuna hua naam; har chakkar mein sequence ki agli cheez is mein aa jati hai.
"in sequence": jis list, tuple, string ya range par chalna hai.
":": aakhir mein colon.
"# code to run for each element in the sequence": yahan indented code aata hai jo har cheez ke liye ek baar chalta hai. Sirf comment rakhne par IndentationError aata hai.
Misaal 1: dosto ki list mein har dost ko "As-Salaam-Alaikum" kahein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"friends = ["Ahmad", "All", "Hassan"]": teen naamon ki list. Kitab "All" chhapti hai (shayad "Ali" ki jagah chhapai ki ghalti); program wahi chhapta hai jo list mein likha hai.
"for friend in friends:": loop list ki har cheez par ek ek kar ke chalta hai; har chakkar mein agla naam friend mein aata hai.
"print("As-Salaam-Alaikum", friend)": har dost ke liye salaam; comma ki wajah se beech mein space.
Output: "As-Salaam-Alaikum Ahmad", "As-Salaam-Alaikum All", "As-Salaam-Alaikum Hassan".
Khud try karein: list mein "Sara" bhi jor dein (["Ahmad", "All", "Hassan", "Sara"]) aur Run karein: chauthi line "As-Salaam-Alaikum Sara" aayegi.
Misaal 2: shopping cart ki cheezon ki total price (kul qeemat) nikalein.

cart = [
    {"item": "Apple", "price": 0.5, "quantity": 4},
    {"item": "Banana", "price": 0.2, "quantity": 10},
    {"item": "Orange", "price": 0.75, "quantity": 3}
    ]
total_price = 0
for product in cart:
    item_total = product["price"] * product["quantity"]
    total_price += item_total
    print(f"{product['item']} total: ${item_total:.2f}")
print(f"Total price of all items: ${total_price:.2f}")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"cart = [ ... ]": list jis ki har cheez dictionary (key aur value ke jore) hai: item (naam), price (ek ki qeemat) aur quantity (kitne).
"total_price = 0": kul qeemat 0 se shuru.
"for product in cart:": har chakkar mein ek dictionary product mein aati hai.
"item_total = product["price"] * product["quantity"]": us cheez ki qeemat: Apple 0.5 * 4 = 2.0, Banana 0.2 * 10 = 2.0, Orange 0.75 * 3 = 2.25.
"total_price += item_total": har item ki qeemat kul mein jurti jati hai.
"print(f"{product['item']} total: ${item_total:.2f}")": f-string mein { } ke andar value aati hai; :.2f number ko do decimal places tak dikhata hai; $ sirf nishan hai.
Aakhri print loop ke baad ek baar chalti hai: 2.0 + 2.0 + 2.25 = 6.25.
Output: "Apple total: $2.00", "Banana total: $2.00", "Orange total: $2.25", "Total price of all items: $6.25".
Khud try karein: Apple ki quantity 6 kar ke Run karein: "Apple total: $3.00" aur kul "$7.25" ho jayega.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab aakhri line print (f "Total price ...") chhapti hai, yani f aur quote ke beech space hai. Is se SyntaxError aata hai. f-string mein f bilkul quote ke saath likha jata hai: print(f"Total price of all items: ${total_price:.2f}").

Apple total: $2.00
Banana total: $2.00
Orange total: $2.25
Total price of all items: $6.25
blocks.caption: Output

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: cart ek list hai jis ki har cheez dictionary (key aur value ke jore) hai. Har product ke liye price * quantity se item_total banta hai (Apple 0.5 * 4 = 2.00) aur total_price mein jurta jata hai. f"..." (f-string) mein { } ke andar variable ki value aa jati hai, aur :.2f ka matlab hai decimal point ke baad do digits.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Python program likhein jo temperatures ki list par chale aur 20 degree se zyada par “Warm” aur 20 ya kam par “Cold” print kare.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: temperatures = [25, 18, 30, 20] ke liye program aur output.
blocks.explanation: for t in temperatures: (andar) if t > 20: print("Warm") else: print("Cold"). Output: Warm, Cold, Warm, Cold (20 "Cold" hai kyunke condition "20 se zyada" hai).

blocks.prompt: List jaisi collection par chalne ke liye kaunsa loop istemal hota hai (MCQ 6)?

items: for: sequence ki har cheez par ek baar.
